description: Incremental runs on SQLite (docs/incremental.md) with a definition that extends sqlite by a query log read through a watermark. Run 1 reads everything. Run 2, after adding a column, a table and two queries (one at the watermark) and dropping a table: only the changes, tombstones for the dropped table and its field, and the new queries without the ones already at the boundary. Run 3, after replacing a view, a normal run: the new view, the old one tombstoned. Run 4 is a reconciliation run (full) after dropping the new view and table: tombstones for them, their fields and keys, and every query again. Run 5, a normal run without changes, emits nothing.
